description:
Create custom dice with text and SVG faces.
An easy to use, reliable, highly performant dice rolling app.

• Story cubes
• Decision dice
• Custom rules
• Dice groups
• Customisable roll history
• Optimised Export/Import
• Yes/No shortcut
• Works offline
• Persistant data
• Open Source
• Free & no ads

Feedback (especially via GitHub Issues) is always appreciated :-)
